## ⚠️ This repository does not accept Pull Requests

This GitHub repo is a **read-only mirror** of release snapshots. Code reviews, merges, and CI happen on a private upstream.

If you have a fix or suggestion, please **open an Issue** with a unified diff (`git diff` output) attached. Approved patches will be applied upstream and shipped in the next release with credit.

— Maintainers
